notes: Station and TV lists load again, now served through Tarang's own service - this update is required, older versions can no longer load them at all. Stations that have gone off air are found and dropped faster, using what actually plays on real phones. Favourites no longer disappear when a language filter is on, and when filters hide everything the screen says so instead of claiming you have no favourites. One equalizer instead of two, and the custom equalizer now has ten bands. New settings: typo-tolerant search, match station names only, Auto EQ switching speed, and how often the list refreshes in the background. The country filter now counts as a filter, and Clear all filters resets it. Two Retry buttons a screen reader could not reach are reachable again.
